description: List all sub-calendars for the current user (e.g. Personal, Work, Holidays).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {cid, name, color} calendars.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new {cid, name, color}.

description: Delete a sub-calendar. All events in this calendar are also removed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains cid and removed_events count.

description: List events, optionally filtered by calendar_id and/or ISO date range. Sorted by start time ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of event summaries.

description: Retrieve the full event object by eid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full event including description and attendees.

description: Create a new event on a calendar.

calendar_id.description: Which calendar to add to (default cal_personal).

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new event summary.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing event. Only supplied fields are changed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated event summary.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {eid, deleted: true}.

description: Reschedule an event to a new start/end time. Shortcut for update_event with just start+end.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the rescheduled event summary.

description: Search events by keyword across title, description, and location.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching event summaries sorted by start time.

description: List the next N events from now (or from the supplied from_date).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

from_date.description: Optional ISO anchor; defaults to the session's initial time.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of upcoming event summaries.

description: List events scheduled for today (or the supplied ISO date).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of event summaries starting on that day.

description: Check whether a time range is free of conflicts against the user's own events.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {free: bool, conflicts: [event_summary, ...]}.

description: Find the first free slot of at least duration_min minutes within [start_date, end_date], respecting the given working-hours window.

start_date.description: ISO datetime lower bound for the search.

end_date.description: ISO datetime upper bound for the search.

working_hours_start.description: Hour of day (0-23) working window starts.

working_hours_end.description: Hour of day (0-23) working window ends.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {start, end} of the first free slot or null if none found.
